title: Audit candidate uses and repairs of the gastric NRRS study
invariants: Gastric cancer; published eight-gene coefficients; explicit patient-level evidence; manuscript goal
learning_objective: Learn to distinguish copying a signature workflow from repairing a measurable scientific question
target_contribution: Select one beginner-executable manuscript route and one backup without treating the anchor label as ground truth
novelty_floor: At least one falsifiable question about transportability or biological construct beyond another high-versus-low risk plot
ambition_ceiling: No neural mechanism, treatment benefit, or clinical deployment claim without orthogonal evidence and genuine external validation
novelty_summary: The anchor is recent but belongs to a saturated signature-plus-omics genre; novelty must come from resolving a validity problem rather than changing the gene set
feasibility_summary: Most public bulk and reference single-cell data are accessible, but exact code and the in-house single-cell cohort are unavailable without access approval
claim_ceiling: Association, transportability, construct validity, and documented failure boundaries only

title: Neural, vascular, or stromal: construct validity and transportability of the published NRRS
invariants: Freeze the published eight genes and coefficients; gastric cancer; independent cohorts; patient as inferential unit
primary_change_axis: Model-building paper to a preregistered construct and transportability audit
secondary_extension: Spatial localization and negative-control programs when feasible
learning_objective: Learn frozen-score reconstruction, cohort lineage, survival validation, confounding decomposition, patient-level single-cell analysis, and sensitivity analysis
target_contribution: A reproducible evidence map showing what the NRRS measures, where it transports, and which conclusions fail after accounting for stage, purity, MSI, endothelial, fibroblast, and epithelial programs
novelty_floor: Resolve whether the nerve label has evidence beyond generic tissue composition and report at least one independent transportability boundary
ambition_ceiling: No absolute-risk calibration without the baseline hazard; no causal neural or treatment-predictive claim; scope ends after the frozen audit and prespecified sensitivity analyses
novelty_summary: A targeted search found many new signatures but no study that jointly freezes this NRRS, audits cohort leakage, decomposes its cell-type signal, and tests neural versus composition alternatives
feasibility_summary: Public bulk cohorts and four public single-cell cohorts are available; GSE251950 and GSE308624 offer conditional spatial checks; unclear z-scoring and cutoff are handled as prespecified sensitivity factors
claim_ceiling: Associational construct validity, relative prognostic transportability, and spatial/cellular localization only

title: Patient-level neural-stromal niche states across gastric cancer progression
invariants: Gastric tissue; patient-level replication; bona fide neural or Schwann evidence; single-cell plus spatial data
primary_change_axis: Bulk prognostic score to measured neural-stromal ecology
secondary_extension: External bulk survival projection after state definition
learning_objective: Learn cell-state annotation, replicate-aware testing, spatial neighborhood analysis, and cross-platform validation
target_contribution: A cross-scale map of neural or Schwann-associated niches and their context-dependent immune or stromal partners
novelty_floor: Detect a reproducible neural or Schwann-associated state in at least two independent spatial or histologic resources before linking it to outcome
ambition_ceiling: No denervation, neural causality, or therapeutic claim; stop if neural structures or adequate patient metadata are absent
novelty_summary: The question is biologically stronger than the anchor score but now competes with recent gastric spatial and nerve-density studies
feasibility_summary: Potential public spatial cohorts exist, but capture of nerves, panel coverage, sample annotation, and code burden require a G1 feasibility spike
claim_ceiling: Associational spatial ecology and prognosis linkage only

title: Reproducible external benchmark of published gastric prognostic signatures
invariants: Gastric cancer survival; frozen published formulas; independent cohorts; clinical-stage baseline
primary_change_axis: Single anchor score to a small preregistered model benchmark
secondary_extension: Reporting and reproducibility audit under TRIPOD and PROBAST
learning_objective: Learn formula extraction, preprocessing harmonization, discrimination, calibration limits, and decision-focused benchmarking
target_contribution: A transparent benchmark showing which published formulas can actually be transported and whether they add information beyond stage
novelty_floor: Include at least three fully specified published models and show a clinically meaningful boundary rather than rank signatures by nominal P values
ambition_ceiling: No refitting disguised as validation and no clinical utility claim without calibration and decision analysis
novelty_summary: Methodologically useful but less biologically distinctive; publication value depends on a carefully selected model set and reproducibility findings
feasibility_summary: Bulk cohorts are abundant, but many papers omit baseline hazards, transformations, or cutoffs and may fail the formula-completeness gate
claim_ceiling: Relative discrimination, reproducibility, and incremental prognostic association only

title: Approximate reconstruction of public-data NRRS figures
invariants: Anchor genes, coefficients, cohort list, and figure logic
secondary_extension: Discrepancy log and reusable dataset adapters
learning_objective: Learn GEO and TCGA preprocessing, survival analysis, single-cell annotation, provenance, and figure verification
target_contribution: A transparent learning reconstruction and a list of irreducible discrepancies; not a manuscript direction by itself
novelty_floor: Not applicable as a new manuscript direction
ambition_ceiling: Do not call the output exact reproduction because code, cutoff, sample filters, baseline hazard, and controlled single-cell data are missing
novelty_summary: High educational value but essentially no stand-alone novelty
feasibility_summary: Bulk and public single-cell figures are approximately reproducible; exact values and in-house single-cell figures are blocked or ambiguous
claim_ceiling: Descriptive similarity and discrepancy reporting only
